summary: sextant-cli-linux-arm64 ships a Go binary implementing a WebSocket/WebRTC remote PTY shell and Anthropic credential harvester
details: The tarball contains only package.json and a 12 MB Linux/arm64 Go ELF at bin/sxt with no source, README, main, or bin field; it is a per-platform payload sibling for a parent sextant-cli CLI. The binary links a PTY library (github.com/creack/pty), a WebSocket client (github.com/coder/websocket), and the pion WebRTC v4 stack (ICE/DTLS/STUN/TURN/SCTP/DataChannel), and embeds the hardcoded control endpoints wss://relay.sextant.top and https://relay.sextant.top/install — a network-sourced control channel plus PTY spawner in one binary, i.e. a remote-controlled shell on the installer's host. The same binary targets Anthropic Claude CLI credentials: it embeds the sk-ant- prefix and the regex sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-], references CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models, and https://claude.ai/install.sh, and the package.json license URL points to a repository literally named ddos798/claude_control. The binary also builds host-geolocation beacons to http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,query and calls Apple Push Notification endpoints (api.push.apple.com and api.sandbox.push.apple.com), which enumerate and announce victim hosts alongside the relay channel.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
